source_kind: peer-shared Hall of Fame snapshot; not independently authenticated against a live platform
row_definition: Each row is one source row. Other displayed names are omitted; is_target identifies exact matches for the target display name. Rows are not assumed to be unique teams or all successful attempts.
ranking_rule_verified_in_export: rank = 1 + number of strictly faster elapsed_ms entries on the same challenge/mode board; equal times share rank and subsequent rank positions skip.
par_interpretation: Value labeled par by the source. No claim that this is a hard deadline or uniform across entrants.
answer_count_interpretation: Source integer field; the export does not define which answer items it counts. Not interpreted as flags, named challenges, participants, or attempts.
